items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the supplied original Elemental Sigil card illustration in rough hand-painted anime concept-art style. The reference is the composition target. Preserve the two orange-red and icy pale-cyan flame streams rising from its left and right upper sides; the right flame reaches higher, and the small dark round cores remain in the same places. Keep the original diamond silhouette, proportions, layered flame overlap and upward directions. No characters, added props or new symbols.
